newsitem.title: UK: Northern Ireland police report blast in Belfast.
newsitem.headline: Northern Ireland police report blast in Belfast.

text.p: Northern Irish police said they were investigating reports of an explosion on Tuesday in nationalist West Belfast.

"We have first reports of an explosion in the Springfield Road -- Kashmir Road," a police spokesman said. Residents added they heard two large blasts about 20 seconds apart at around 1840 GMT. No other details were available.

The reported blast coincides with heightened tensions in the British province following a surge in hostilities by members of the Irish Republican Army (IRA) and revenge attacks by their pro-British Loyalist foes.
The IRA abandoned its 17-month ceasefire in a war against British rule last February, citing frustration at being kept out of peace talks.
Britain says the IRA must call a truce before its political wing, Sinn Fein, is given a place in multi-party discussions on the future of the province.
